description: This file defines the HookListener interface, which extends Spring's ApplicationListener for handling HookEvent events within the Fineract project. It establishes a contract for classes that will listen to hook events.

classes.name: HookListener
classes.description: An interface that extends ApplicationListener for handling HookEvent instances within the application.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Method inherited from ApplicationListener, invoked when a HookEvent occurs.
